target_customer: Brazilian individuals (CPF) and businesses (CNPJ) that earn, hold or send US dollars
problem: Receiving and converting USD in Brazil is slow and expensive through banks, SWIFT and IOF tax; users want dollar accounts linked to Pix.
business_model: transaction and conversion fees (from 0.3 percent advertised) plus card and yield partnerships
product_category: cross-border dollar account (Pix, stablecoin and Visa rails)

founders.name: Alec Howard
founders.background_notes: YC page lists Lambda School, YC S17 in parentheses; unclear if education.

founders.name: Michael Mason
prior_employers: Mercato (co-founder, head of Product and Engineering)

founders.name: Carlos
founders.background_notes: Named in the YC launch post per the YC page; surname not found.

competitors.name: Nomad
competitors.what: US dollar account and debit card for Brazilians

competitors.name: Wise
competitors.what: Multi-currency account and travel card in Brazil

competitors.name: C6 Bank
competitors.what: Brazilian bank with a dollar account

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating Pix, stablecoin rails, Visa card issuing and US account partners with compliance; mostly integration of partners rather than novel technology.

defensibility.rationale: Relies on licensed partners and commodity rails; the company states it does not custody funds or perform regulated activities in Brazil, so competitors can replicate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established players already served dollar accounts; OKX also launched a Pix linked stablecoin card in Brazil; Ruvo kept growing as of 2026.

market_need_then: Large Brazil and US corridor, Pix adoption, and stablecoin rails made faster cheaper USD to BRL transfers possible; users faced IOF tax and slow SWIFT.

branding.domain_note: Trademark RUVO filed 2025-09-17 by Cacao Financial Intermediate Holdings (USPTO listing); domain ruvo.com in use.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain consumer finance language, Made in Brazil footer

rebrands.why: Not stated; trademark for RUVO filed September 2025 under the Cacao entity. Date is the filing, not an announcement.

branding.community_and_virality: Press such as Brazil Journal framed it as the ex-Uber founder's fintech; no merch or community found.

brand_strength.rationale: Name change within months of launch; the brand is new and press attention is about the founder and funding rather than the brand.

outcome_analysis: Ruvo, launched as Cacao in the Summer 2025 batch, connected Pix, stablecoins and Visa into a dollar account for Brazilians and closed a $4.6M seed round led by 1confirmation within months, helped by the Pix and stablecoin tailwind and strong investor interest in Brazil to US payments. It is still active with competition from Wise, Nomad and Revolut, so the long term outcome is open.
notes: Seed date varies by source (January or February 2026); recorded as 2026-02 from the YC page headline date. NeoFeed claims an earlier R$3 million pre-seed from Alliance in 2025, and VCBacked lists $500K pre-seed in Sep 2025; single sources, unverified, not recorded as rounds. A September 2026 Exame headline calls it a R$1 billion fintech with no context. Competitors cited from a 2023 article because nothing closer to the batch was found. Mind the unrelated Caccao fintech. Company site does not mention the rename.
